description: Third attempt at the CM-MNIST two-epoch sanity gate: LSTM, mLSTM, HyperLSTM, and BRIMs at seed 1, with a compute-node-safe (git-free) source guard.
notes: Source commit 1f8795e15074a28e851cb76f9dd634a13af57f50 in pinned worktree dynamic_baselines_1f8795e; array 0-3%4 followed by afterok preflight aggregate 61723315, which writes /scratch/js3269/results/artifacts/dynamic_weight_baselines_2epoch_seed1_v3/summary.json and gates the formal submission.

Compute-node source guard is git-free: experiments/remote/amarel_source_guard.sh resolves the checked-out commit from git metadata with shell builtins and falls back to the submit-time stamp status/source_commit.txt; every run script writes its own .fail marker when the guard fails.

Superseded attempt 61717748 (artifact root dynamic_weight_baselines_2epoch_seed1_v2_gitpath) was released on 2026-09-20 18:57:26 EDT and failed all four tasks within 0-4 s on gpu034 with 'Git executable unavailable: /usr/bin/git', because the retry hard-coded the login-node git path.
Stale never-runnable preaggregate 61717749 (DependencyNeverSatisfied after 61717748 failed) was cancelled on 2026-09-20 19:28 EDT.

AIM3_ARTIFACT_ROOT is pinned to .../dynamic_weight_baselines_2epoch_seed1_v3 because the v1 and v2_gitpath artifact roots already exist; the preflight result tag dynamic_weight_baselines_2epoch_seed1_v1 had never been created.
